nodes.label: ICRR Journal Design Handoff
nodes.rationale: High fidelity handoff: colors, typography, spacing, borders, animation timings and all copy are final. Where this README and the HTML disagree, the HTML wins. Not final: the six author profiles and article body text.

nodes.label: Pre-Launch Honesty in Copy
nodes.rationale: The journal has not published anything yet and the copy is deliberately honest about that ('Issue 1 publishing 30 September 2026', 'Appointment pending', 'Recruiting') rather than filled with fake articles. Two sections are explicitly marked as design previews and hidden by a single showPreviewNotes flag.

nodes.label: Do Not Port the Prototype Runtime
nodes.rationale: ICRR Journal.dc.html is authored in a lightweight in-house template runtime with a React-like component class; it is a design reference, not production code. The prototype keeps all ten views in one file and swaps them with a `page` state variable purely so the whole thing previews in a single browser tab. Do not replicate that pattern, use real routes.

nodes.label: Design Token Palette (14 colors)
nodes.rationale: From the ICRR brand guidelines. Only maroon #5D1D21, maroon-hover #7C2A2F, maroon-deep #3F1417, gold #C0A265, gold-muted #8A7B5C, cream #F7F4EF, cream-tint #FBF7EE, page #FDFBF7, ink #241F1E, ink-soft #3F3733, body #5A524A, body-muted #6E655C, rule #E2DACB, rule-light #EFE9DF, plus black/white and a short list of inline rgba values.

nodes.label: Typography System (Libre Baskerville + Lato)
nodes.rationale: Two families only. Libre Baskerville (fallback Georgia, serif) for headings, pull quotes, article body, issue numbers, drawer nav, author names, hero caption, footer wordmark; Lato (fallback system-ui) for body copy, nav, buttons, labels, forms, tables. Fluid sizes are reproduced as clamp() verbatim rather than converted to breakpoints. Measure caps: headline 22ch, hero lead 64ch, intro 66-70ch, article body 74ch, hero caption 34ch.

nodes.label: No Border Radius Anywhere
nodes.rationale: Every corner is square. This is intentional: it is what makes the site read as a print journal rather than a SaaS product.

nodes.label: One Shadow in the Whole Design
nodes.rationale: The toast alone carries box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(36,31,30,.28). No other box-shadow may appear.

nodes.label: Three Rule Treatments
nodes.rationale: The print-journal character comes almost entirely from three rule treatments: double rule 3px double #5D1D21 under the masthead, under every page heading and as the drawer's left border; hairline 1px solid #E2DACB for card borders, table rows and list dividers; gold hairline 1px solid #C0A265 only on highlighted callouts, always with #FBF7EE fill.

nodes.label: Ten-View Route Map
nodes.rationale: Home /, About /about, Current Issue /issue/current, Archives /archives, Authors /authors, Author profile /authors/[slug], Our Team /team, Submit /submit, Announcements /news, Article /articles/[slug].

nodes.label: Top Strip
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed maroon, cream at .82, 11px uppercase. On a narrow screen the two halves wrap onto separate lines and both centre; pushed apart they read as an accidental break.

nodes.label: Masthead Lockup Sizing
nodes.rationale: Sized by height at clamp(72px,9.5vw,92px) with width auto, not by a fixed box: the file is 2500x600 and the prototype's 454x126 box did not match that ratio, so object-contain letterboxed the artwork and it drew smaller than the number implied.

nodes.label: Sticky Nav, Two Variants at 860px
nodes.rationale: Layout is justify-content: space-between with the link row as flex: 1, NOT absolute positioning; an earlier version used position:absolute for Submit and the links ran underneath it. Inactive links keep a 2px solid transparent border so nothing shifts. The switch is driven by window.matchMedia('(max-width: 860px)') with a change listener, not by CSS display, because the two variants have different DOM. Resizing above 860px force-closes the drawer.

nodes.label: Mobile Drawer
nodes.rationale: Right-hand sheet min(86vw, 340px) with border-left 3px double maroon over a rgba(36,31,30,.5) scrim. Clicks inside the sheet must stop propagation or the scrim handler closes it. Hamburger bars morph to a cross on open.

nodes.label: Footer Brand Block
nodes.rationale: Uses lockup-stacked-white.png, the stacked lockup drawn for dark grounds, because it carries mark and wordmark in one transparent file so nothing sits beside it. Do not put a cream or white rectangle behind a lockup to make it legible on maroon; the plate looks pasted on. The file is cropped to its artwork, so breathing room belongs to the layout, not the file.

nodes.label: Toast
nodes.rationale: Fixed bottom 30px, centered, z-index 80, ink fill, cream text, the one shadow, slides up via icrrUp 300ms, auto-dismisses after 3600ms.

nodes.label: Continuous Announcement Ticker
nodes.rationale: The line slides continuously (icrrTicker, linear, infinite); it does not swap every 6000ms as the prototype did, because a swap takes a line away half way through being read. The track holds the three strings twice over and travels translateX(-50%) so the loop has no seam. Duration is 0.11s per character with a 30s floor, keeping speed constant however much there is to say. Pauses on hover and focus-within; ends softened by mask-image rather than a coloured gradient; collapses to static text under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Scroll Reveal with the 92% Above-the-Fold Guard
nodes.rationale: IntersectionObserver with rootMargin '0px 0px -12% 0px' sets opacity 1 and transform none, then unobserves. Elements already within 92% of the viewport height on arrival are skipped entirely and never hidden, so nothing above the fold flashes blank.

nodes.label: Named Keyframe Animations
nodes.rationale: icrrUp, icrrIn, icrrDraw, icrrPlate, icrrPulse, icrrDrawer, icrrTicker. Standard easing outside these is cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1).

nodes.label: Authors Filter and Search
nodes.rationale: Six chips plus a search input. Search matches case-insensitive substring against name, affiliation, discipline, role, bio, research interests and publication titles. Live count reads '6 contributors' or '3 of 6 contributors'. The six profiles are placeholders that exist so filter, search, empty state and the profile route are all demonstrable.

nodes.label: Placeholder Toast Actions
nodes.rationale: Every action with no backend yet shows a toast rather than doing nothing. In the real build, wire these up or hide the affordance, do not ship the toasts.

nodes.label: Two Breakpoints (860px and 640px)
nodes.rationale: 860px switches the nav and is the only breakpoint that changes what is in the DOM. 640px is where fixed-width rows stop being rows and become stacks. Each was measured on a 375px screen first: a fixed column comfortable at 1180px takes half a phone and leaves its content wrapping four deep, which is what made the small layout look like a mistake rather than a choice. Everything else is fluid via auto-fit minmax and clamp().

nodes.label: Three Editorial Copy Rules
nodes.rationale: 1) No em dashes anywhere; en dashes in numeric ranges are fine. 2) Never promise reviewer feedback to authors, because the journal cannot guarantee it. 3) Never name a review model and never put a number of reviewers on a paper: the journal reviews what it publishes but does not run double-blind or formal peer review, so 'reviewed' is as specific as any page may get. Recruiting copy is exempt from the spirit but not the letter.

nodes.label: About Page Review-Policy Copy Constraint
nodes.rationale: An earlier draft said every author receives written feedback; that was removed because the journal cannot guarantee it. The double-blind wording went the same way: the journal reviews what it publishes but does not run double-blind or formal peer review, so claiming either promised a process that does not exist.

nodes.label: "Our Team" Rename from "Editorial Board"
nodes.rationale: The nav label, page title, mobile drawer entry, footer link, and one news CTA all say 'Our Team' / 'Our team' / 'Meet the team'. Editor-in-Chief is intentionally absent from the editorial roles list because Ayla covers it in the core team.

nodes.label: Prototype State to Real State Mapping
nodes.rationale: page becomes real routing, authorId becomes the [slug] param, filter and q are worth putting in the URL, ann is gone because the bar slides in CSS, toast auto-clears after 3600ms, narrow comes from matchMedia and menuOpen is force-closed when narrow goes false.

nodes.label: Brand Assets and Missing Photographs
nodes.rationale: Shipped in public/brand: lockup-full.png (2500x600) for the masthead, lockup-stacked-white.png (956x686) for the footer, lockup-stacked.png and mark.png unused. Six slot types still need real photographs.
